title: In 8 months, it became the single AI product providing the most tokens in China, but Tencent's Executive Office says AI application development has only just begun
excerpt: Tencent Culture published an article on November 16 titled "Executive Committee Calls for Re-entrepreneurship in the AI Era, 'Reset Your Mindset to Zero,'" reca
content_html:
Tencent Culture published an article on November 16 titled "Executive Committee Calls for Re-entrepreneurship in the AI Era, 'Reset Your Mindset to Zero,'" recapping, in the form of on-site notes from the 2026 Executive Committee LinkTime, the anniversary speech that had previously sparked heated public discussion. On the company's 28th birthday, the Executive Committee turned the annual LinkTime into a podcast; Pony and Martin said it was an honor to participate in this technological transformation and stand at the forefront.

The notes characterize the intelligent revolution as "a matter of life and death": if you do not invest and embrace it, you will be disrupted. Unlike previous passive cost-cutting, this round is about proactively improving efficiency. AI-native businesses, models, and products must swim against the current, and all businesses must re-entrepreneur for the AI era. At present, domestic competition is fierce, and AI monetization is especially difficult.

The Executive Committee explained that AI is still in its early stage, infrastructure and computing power must be built in-house, and with all parties investing at the same time, prices are soaring. "If we don't invest now, we may not even have a chance to participate later," it said, while also stressing the need to pragmatically assess ROI. Tencent also proposed building human-centered AI, insisting that AI must benefit humanity and society, must be controlled by humans, and must empower human creativity.

Tencent said its "AI pyramid" is beginning to take shape: its core models have entered the top tier in China and will continue to iterate to drive an exponential decline in intelligence costs; Xiaowei is positioned as a personal private AI assistant, with the goal of "token freedom"; Yuanbao serves as an advisor for decision-making and information; and WorkBuddy, within eight months, became the single AI product in China that provides the most tokens, making it the first AI-native product to break out.
